name: Reed Animal Hospital
description: Reed Animal Hospital provides veterinary care for dogs in Campbell, CA. Confirm hours and services directly with the clinic.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Reed Animal Hospital always treats our pets like family. Compassionate, thorough, and so gentle at every visit.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Dr. Reed and his team went above and beyond during a scary emergency. Our dog is here today because of them.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: We’ve trusted Reed Animal Hospital for years. Consistent, compassionate care from every doctor and every staff member.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: From check‑in to follow‑up calls, the staff is warm, patient, and professional. We won’t go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Dr. Johnson and the staff treated our anxious pup with so much patience and empathy. Truly 5‑star care.
